title: Controls calibrated against the camera
body: Until then the recipe controls were educated guesses. On 25 September each was measured against the camera, one at a time: colour, white-balance shift, highlight, shadow, dynamic range and colour chrome. For each one I converted the same RAW in the camera's own converter with only that control changed, and fitted Fonder's control to match.
Then every recipe was retuned onto the calibrated controls so it kept the look already approved. Most landed within 2 ΔE of their old look.
